title: Return from Germany and Hershey Kay's musicals
summary: Little work back home; commercials and Broadway musicals followed.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Good. I liked the people very much, but it just didn't work out properly. The living was great. I think I'll take a run
over there this autumn if I get a chance. I like to, to say hello to everybody.
I came back here and there was nothing. Ray Sheiner, the oboist, got me onto a couple of commercials, but I couldn't live on what I was getting.
Hershey Kay latched onto a musical and I started doing that. So then we began eating a little regularly and the kids went to school and we got all that taken care of.
That's about where it's been ever since.
